Names and attributes of Allah
Two names or an attribute at the end of an Ayah. Usually one order is the rule and the other appears in only a few places.
Attribute before or after بما تعملون
With خبير both orders are almost balanced, with بصير the final position is the rule.
Sentence structure with كان
The same words, but كان stands once before and once after the name of Allah or the subject.
وكان الله … or إن الله كان …
Almost all places are in An-Nisa’, Al-Ahzab and Al-Fath. What decides is the beginning of the closing sentence: وكان الله or إن الله كان.
Heaven and earth
The heaven almost always comes before the earth. The few exceptions are worth memorising one by one.
Heaven before earth, earth before heaven
ما في السماوات والأرض and related
With ما or مَن: once ما في is repeated before the earth, once it is not.
Word pairs
Two terms that belong together, in changing order.
Harm and benefit
Play and amusement
Sight, hearing, hearts, hands
People and nations
Names in a fixed order and the places where they are swapped.
Musa and Harun
The position of مِن
Here a small word moves, usually مِن. Such places slip especially easily when reciting.
أرسلنا من قبلك
أهلكنا
Word order in the sentence
Single parts of the sentence swap places. Almost always it is only two or three places in the whole Qur’an.
